Interface ClassIndex

public interface ClassIndex
The view of the class path a curated module is resolved against. The Python processor implements it over its visitor context and the editor stub generators over the class files they read, so both resolve a module to the same names.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher
